scope_of_deliverables.quote:
Scope of Work
RFP CMH26-85 – Learning Management System (LMS)
Data Migration
• Migration of users, organization hierarchy.
• Vendor to provide mapping templates, test plan, and reconciliation process.
Testing
• SIT (system/integration testing) and UAT with City test scripts; defect triage; performance testing; accessibility verification.
Training & Change Management
• Admin training (advanced and day-to-day), instructor training, manager training, and learner quick guides.
• Training materials in editable formats (PowerPoint/Word/PDF); short video tutorials preferred.
Go-Live & Hypercare
• Cutover plan, rollback criteria, and communication plan.
• Hypercare for at least 30 days post go-live with defined response/resolution targets.
4) Support & SLAs
Includes support channels, SLA response/resolution timelines, maintenance windows, release schedules.
5) Deliverables & Milestones
Covers project plan, design, sandbox configuration, migration, UAT, training, go-live, and hypercare.
scope_of_deliverables.value: The City of Medicine Hat is seeking a Learning Management System (LMS) with deliverables including data migration, system testing (SIT and UAT), training and change management, go-live and hypercare (at least 30 days post go-live), support and SLAs, and defined deliverables and milestones covering project plan, design, sandbox configuration, migration, UAT, training, go-live, and hypercare.

evaluation_criteria.quote:
G. RATED CRITERIA
The following sets out the categories, weightings, and descriptions of the rated criteria of the RFP. Proponents who do not meet a minimum threshold score for a category will not proceed to the next stage of the evaluation process.
Product Demonstration:
The evaluation will be conducted in two stages. In Stage 1, all proposals will be evaluated against the rated criteria for a subtotal of 100 points, including a technical component worth 50 points. Proponents must achieve a minimum technical score of 35 out of 50 points to meet the technical threshold.
The top-ranked proponents that meet the technical threshold, up to a maximum of six, may be invited to participate in Stage 2, at the City's discretion. Stage 2 will consist of a product demonstration.
Stage 2 demonstrations will be scored out of 30 points and added to the Stage 1 scores to determine the final ranking (Total = 130 points).
Rated Criteria Category	Weighting (Points)	Minimum Threshold
Stage 1 Initial Evaluation
Technical Capability (Appendix E) – Initial	50	35

pricing_structure.quote: Proponents should provide the information requested under section 3 below ("Required Pricing Information") by completing the attached form and including it in their proposals. Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except for GST, which should be itemized separately. Rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive and must include all labour and material costs, all travel and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all COVID-19 related costs (including without limitation all cross border isolation/quarantine costs, schedule delay costs and personal protective equipment costs), all costs of delivery, all costs of installation and set-up, including any pre-delivery inspection charges, and all other overhead, including any fees or other charges required by law. The effects (if any) of any addenda issued must be included in all pricing.

insurance_requirements.quote: 2.2.1. Commercial General Liability Insurance in respect to the Services and operations of the Contractor for bodily injury and/or property damage with policy limits. Not less than Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000.00) per occurrence with a property damage deductible not exceeding Two Thousand Five Hundred ($2,500.00) Dollars. The insurance shall include, to the satisfaction of the City: 2.2.1.1 The City of Medicine Hat as an Additional Insured; 2.2.1.2 Standard non-owned automobile liability; 2.2.1.3 Broad Form Products and Completed Operations Liability; 2.2.1.4 Cross liability; 2.2.1.5 Employer’s liability insurance with limits of liability of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000.00) per employee for each accidental injury to, or death of, an employee of the Consultant or of a sub-consultant, engaged in the Services; Or Contingent Employer’s liability 2.2.2. Professional Errors and Omissions Liability Insurance in respect to the Services with policy limits of not less than One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) per claim with a 12-month maintenance period, a deductible of not more than $25,000 and with an aggregate limit of not less than $2,000,000.
